title: Polish Crumble Cake
description: A delicious Polish-inspired cake topped with a crunchy crumble made with almonds.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add eggs one at a time, whisking well after each addition.
Whisk in milk and vanilla extract.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
While cake is baking, prepare crumble topping by mixing together almonds, crumble, and sugar in a small bowl.
Remove cake from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Top cake with crumble mixture and return to oven for an additional 5-7 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool completely on a wire rack.
